authority: Nebraska Secretary of State and Nebraska county election offices

sameGrainComparison.requestPath: Ask the Nebraska Secretary of State Elections Division or the relevant county election offices for official 2024 general election precinct or local reporting-unit result rows for President and U.S. Senate, including join keys and any reporting-unit crosswalk used by the canvass or tabulation system.
sameGrainComparison.caveat: Current review rows are official county-level President-versus-U.S. Senate two-year special election comparisons. The public SOS previous-elections page exposes canvass PDFs, but this pass did not identify an official statewide precinct/subcounty President plus U.S. Senate result export.

turnoutDenominators.parserNeeded: A Nebraska canvass voting-statistics normalizer should parse pages 6-9 of the official canvass book before replacing the EAC fallback rows. It should reconcile the canvass statewide total voting value of 965,236 against the current EAC fallback ballots-cast total of 965,145 and keep the source distinction visible.
turnoutDenominators.caveat: The current ETL still emits EAC fallback turnout rows. The official canvass and post-general registration reports are retained as state-native source paths and cross-checks, not yet as normalized turnout rows.

sourcePathNotes: The SOS District & Subdivision Maps page publishes statewide district maps and GIS shapefiles for congressional, legislative, regent, state board of education, public service commission, and supreme court districts.
The voter-file request path documents precinct, polling place, district details, and voter history fields, but the file is restricted and cannot be posted or made accessible on the Internet.
The county election office directory is the official path for county-level requests if precinct boundary geometry or reporting-unit crosswalks are maintained locally.
geometry.needed: Official precinct/subcounty boundary geometry or a publishable reporting-unit crosswalk matching any lower-level President and U.S. Senate result rows.
geometry.caveat: District shapefiles are not a substitute for precinct or reporting-unit boundaries. Do not infer precinct geometry from voter-file fields or county names.

identifiedItems.summary: Dawson Public Power District Dawson Subdivision was listed as vote-for-one instead of vote-for-up-to-two on ballots sent before corrected ballots were issued.
Lower Big Blue NRD Subdistrict 1 was omitted from 32 of 41 ballot styles; the canvass states the one-candidate contest was not outcome-impacting.
State Board of Education District 2 was omitted from one ballot style in one precinct; the canvass states the margin meant the issue did not impact the outcome.

reportedProblemsCorrectionsIncidents.caveat: These are official canvass-reported administration notes. They are not normalized incident or litigation rows and are not evidence of fraud or misconduct.

auditRecountCvrLitigation.requestPath: Use the Nebraska Secretary of State Elections Division contact path (sos.elect@nebraska.gov, 402-471-2555) and county election office directory for records that are not posted on the public previous-elections or canvass pages.
auditRecountCvrLitigation.caveat: No statewide CVR dataset, post-election audit result table, recount package, or litigation row package is loaded in this repository for Nebraska 2024.

equipmentContext.officialRequestPath: The SOS Elections Division page states that the division oversees election tabulation equipment; request official county equipment records from the Nebraska Secretary of State Elections Division or county election offices when source-native equipment provenance is required.
equipmentContext.caveat: Verified Voting rows are context only and should not be used as vote, turnout, or precinct-uniformity proof.
